verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any first-party way to operate n8n itself (building, editing or running workflows) through natural-language commands, such as a built-in AI assistant or prompt-to-workflow feature. The 'Convert natural language into API calls' homepage item is a use case users can build as a workflow, not a way to control the product. The MCP Server Trigger and agent nodes are building blocks for constructing agentic workflows, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
